responsibility: Small declaration-processing header that defines shared declaration-context enums and prototypes needed by declarator handling. In practice it provides the canonical decl_context classification used by grokdeclarator and related declaration code, plus the deprecated-state interface that controls how declaration processing suppresses or propagates deprecated-item diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the lightweight shared declaration-processing interface needed by declarator code, chiefly the decl_context enum used by grokdeclarator and deprecated-state declarations. Unlike decl.cc, it does not implement declaration construction, validation, or global declaration state management.
